# Quarter

> Quarter is a payment firewall. It checks every outgoing business payment before it leaves the bank. A business uploads a vendor payment run (a NACHA file, a CSV, or a JSON list of payments) before sending it to its bank. Quarter matches each payment to a known vendor, runs thirteen checks, and holds suspicious payments for a person to approve or reject, with the reason in plain words. When no payment is held, release returns the file without the rejected payments, NACHA control totals recomputed. Vendors can confirm their own bank details by logging in to their bank (Plaid) through a verification link, and staff call-backs are recorded with where the phone number came from. Everything goes into an audit trail, and Quarter generates a written fraud-monitoring procedure from the settings.

Quarter never holds, moves or sends money: the cleaned file goes back to the customer, who uploads it to their own bank. Account numbers are sealed at rest and responses show only the last 4 digits. The cross-customer network (account checks and fraud reports) shares counts only, never which customer verified or reported an account. Quarter gives a documented, risk-based process and the evidence it was followed, which helps a business meet Nacha's fraud-monitoring rule; it does not make anyone compliant and does not guarantee that every fraud is caught.

Status: Quarter is pre-launch, with no customers yet. The api described here is built and tested: vendors and bank details, verification links, call-backs, payment runs in NACHA, CSV and JSON, the thirteen checks, decisions with two-person approval, release, account checks, fraud reports, settings, the generated procedure, the audit log, events and signed webhooks. The network is built, and it fills as customers join. During early access, Quarter issues API keys and the API URL.

Every docs page below is plain Markdown. The whole set is one file at [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt). The exact contract of every route is an OpenAPI 3.1 document at `GET $QUARTER_API_URL/openapi.json`, which needs no key. Examples use `$QUARTER_API_URL` for the API URL and `$QUARTER_API_KEY` for the key. Test keys start with `qk_test_`, live keys with `qk_live_`; send them as a Bearer token on every `/v1` route and keep them on a server. The `/verify` routes are public and take the token in the link instead. Start with the [quickstart](/docs/quickstart.md); look up any finding code in [checks](/docs/checks.md).

## Get started

- [Overview](/docs.md): Check every outgoing vendor payment before it leaves your bank. Hold the suspicious ones for a person, with the reason in plain words.
- [Quickstart](/docs/quickstart.md): Add a vendor, confirm its bank details, upload a small payment run, decide the held payment and get the file back.

## Vendors

- [Vendors and bank details](/docs/vendors.md): Add the people you pay, record their bank details, and see why a change of bank details holds payments until it is confirmed.
- [Verification links](/docs/verification.md): Send a vendor a link where they confirm their own bank details by logging in to their bank.
- [Call-backs](/docs/callbacks.md): Record that someone at your company phoned the vendor at a number you already had and confirmed the bank details.

## Payment runs

- [Payment runs](/docs/payment-runs.md): Upload a NACHA file, a CSV or a list of payments, and get every payment back clear or held, with its findings.
- [Checks](/docs/checks.md): The thirteen checks Quarter runs on every payment, what each one means, and the exact message it gives.
- [Decisions and release](/docs/releases.md): Approve or reject each held payment with a reason, then release the run and get back the file to send to your bank.

## Network

- [Account checks](/docs/account-checks.md): Check bank details before you pay them: routing number, the network, your own vendor records and sanctions name screening.
- [Fraud reports](/docs/fraud-reports.md): Report a bank account used in a payment fraud against you, so every business on Quarter holds payments to it.

## Compliance

- [Settings](/docs/settings.md): Choose how each check acts, the cooling period, the unusual amount multiplier and the two-person threshold.
- [Procedure and audit log](/docs/procedure.md): The written fraud-monitoring procedure Quarter generates from your settings, its yearly review, and the audit log that shows you followed it.

## Reference

- [Webhooks and events](/docs/webhooks.md): Event types, the signed delivery format, how to verify quarter-signature, and how retries work.
- [Errors](/docs/errors.md): The error shape, the error types and their HTTP status, and every error code the api returns.

## Optional

- [Full docs in one file](/llms-full.txt): every page above, concatenated.
